headline.purpose: Section headings, one line on wide screens.

price.purpose: Static money values in Gabarito with tabular figures.

figure.purpose: Ticking clocks, bids and code digits in Figtree tabular.

shadows.name: hairline
shadows.purpose: Outline of every panel and card; the only surface edge.

motion.name: ease-rise
motion.purpose: Hero entrance (rise 600ms, window slide 800ms after 200ms) and photo zoom (400ms).

motion.name: hover-fast
motion.purpose: Button and chip colour and 2px lift transitions.

motion.name: ping
motion.purpose: Live dots (vermilion in the hero, error pink on the auction).

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion disables every animation; WebGL ground draws one still frame.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one hot action: Sell, search submit.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 1.5rem; border-radius: 10px; background: #ff6b35; color: #0a1018; font-family: 'Figtree Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; transition: transform 140ms, background 140ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #ff8a5c; transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #fff; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Hero Search
components.description: The single action in the hero: a white field with a vermilion submit.
components.css: .ds-search { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; max-width: 34rem; padding: 0.375rem 0.375rem 0.375rem 1rem; border-radius: 10px; background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.96); box-shadow: 0 18px 40px -18px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.55); } .ds-search:focus-within { outline: 2px solid #ff6b35; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-search input { flex: 1; min-width: 0; min-height: 48px; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; font: inherit; font-size: 1.0625rem; color: #0f1720; } .ds-search button { min-height: 48px; padding: 0 1.5rem; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: #ff6b35; color: #0a1018; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; } .ds-search button:hover { background: #ff8a5c; }

components.name: Category Chip
components.description: Horizontal category strip item; the first one (All) wears the held brown.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 1rem; border-radius: 10px; background: #131f2e; color: #f2f5f9; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; transition: background 140ms, transform 140ms; } .ds-chip:hover { background: #2a1b14; transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ff8a5c; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Bento Card
components.description: Panel colour with a 1px hairline, 16px radius; the safety explanation unit.
components.html:
Money held until you have it

Your payment stays with us until you confirm the item.
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.75rem; padding: 1.5rem; border-radius: 16px; background: #0f1824; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #213145; color: #f2f5f9; max-width: 22rem; } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0; font-family: 'Gabarito Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 1.375rem; letter-spacing: -0.02em; line-height: 1.2; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; color: #9fb0c3; max-width: 36ch; }

components.name: Held-Money Card
components.description: The one accented card: brown tint with a vermilion-tinted hairline.
components.html:
Payment held

Released only after the handover code.
components.css: .ds-held { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.75rem; padding: 1.5rem; border-radius: 16px; background: #2a1b14; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(255 107 53 / 0.28); color: #f2f5f9; max-width: 22rem; } .ds-held h3 { margin: 0; font-family: 'Gabarito Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 1.375rem; letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-held p { margin: 0; color: #d6c3b8; }

components.name: Escrow Timeline
components.description: Three payment steps; green marks the current held state.
components.css: .ds-tl { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; width: 14rem; color: #9fb0c3; font-family: 'Figtree Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-tl li { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.875rem; padding: 0.75rem 0; font-weight: 500; } .ds-tl li + li { border-top: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.1); } .ds-tl li::before { content: ''; flex: none; width: 16px; height: 16px; border-radius: 50%; border: 2px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.4); } .ds-tl .done { color: #f2f5f9; } .ds-tl .done::before { background: #f2f5f9; border-color: #f2f5f9; } .ds-tl .now { color: #fff; font-weight: 650; } .ds-tl .now::before { background: #5dd39e; border-color: #5dd39e; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgb(93 211 158 / 0.22); }

components.name: Glass Window (home only)
components.description: The hero's frosted product window; not for reuse on other screens.
components.css: .ds-glass { display: grid; gap: 0.25rem; padding: 1.25rem 1.5rem; border-radius: 16px; background: rgb(10 16 24 / 0.72); border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.2); backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(1.5); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.3), 0 40px 80px -30px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.7); color: #fff; font-family: 'Figtree Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-price { font-family: 'Gabarito Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.75rem; letter-spacing: -0.02em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

narrative.overview: TrustBazaar is a marketplace for buyers in Bangladesh, in English and Bangla at equal weight. The shipped home page sets it as a night market: a near-black navy ground, panels one step lighter, and a single vermilion that does all the calling. The page proves safety by showing the mechanism (a real listing, a live clock, a "Payment held" card) rather than asserting it with a badge. The system is flat: every surface is a panel colour with a 1px hairline. The one exception is the home hero, with a moving WebGL gradient ground and a frosted-glass product window; these exist only on the home hero.
keyCharacteristics: Dark theme on the user app; console, ID check and credentials pages stay light.
One surface system: panel colour plus a 1px inset hairline, three radii (24, 16, 10).
Gabarito for headlines at weight 500, Figtree for text and every ticking figure.
Hero fills the first screen alone; its moving ground falls back to a still CSS gradient.
44px minimum tap targets; reduced motion switches every animation off.

rules.name: The One Hot Colour Rule
rules.body: Vermilion is the only hot colour. It marks an action or a live signal; it is never decoration, never a large fill, and never carries white text.

rules.name: The Protect Green Rule
rules.body: Green means held or verified money and nothing else.

rules.name: The Held Brown Rule
rules.body: The brown tint belongs to the held-money card and its step markers.

rules.name: The Ticking Figures Rule
rules.body: Anything that updates in place is Figtree with tabular-nums. Gabarito is for static display and prices.

rules.name: The Bangla Face Rule
rules.body: In Bangla the stack becomes TB Figures, Hind Siliguri, Figtree, line height 1.7 for body and 1.3 to 1.4 for headings, letter-spacing 0 on headings and prices.

rules.name: The One Surface Rule
rules.body: Panel colour plus a 1px hairline is the only surface. No second card style.

rules.name: The Home-Only Glass Rule
rules.body: The WebGL gradient ground and the frosted-glass window with its sheen exist only on the home hero.

dos: Do keep every surface to panel colour plus a 1px hairline, with radii of 24 (panels), 16 (cards) and 10 (controls).
Do reserve vermilion (#ff6b35) for actions and live signals, with #0a1018 text on it.
Do use Protect Green only for held or verified states, and Held Brown for the held-money card.
Do set headings in Gabarito 500 and all ticking figures in Figtree with tabular numerals.
Do keep tap targets at 44px minimum and design for 320px, phones under 768, tablets 768 to 1023, laptops 1024 and up.
Do keep a still fallback for any animation and honour prefers-reduced-motion.
Do keep Bangla on Hind Siliguri with the TB Figures digits first in the stack, at line height 1.7.
donts: Don't use the WebGL ground, backdrop blur or the glass sheen outside the home hero.
Don't put white text on vermilion or use vermilion as a large background fill.
Don't add a fourth radius or a second card style.
Don't use Protect Green or Error Pink as decoration.
Don't set a changing number in Gabarito.
Don't let the held-money brown tint spread to ordinary cards.
Don't convey state by colour alone; the timeline pairs fill with text weight and the clock pairs colour with its label.
